call_points.text: EBITDA improved by 24.8% year-on-year driven by sales mix and operational efficiencies.
Signed a formal agreement for a solar captive electricity project in the Khopoli plant, expected to go live in the second half.
Raw materials saw low to medium double-digit inflation, but the company successfully passed on most costs to customers.
An exceptional prior-period depreciation charge of INR 88 million was taken due to an error in calculating depreciation on WDV instead of SLM for 2024 and 2025.
Q1 2026 net sales remained stable while margins improved due to favorable mix and efficiencies.

industry: Industrials > Capital Goods > Industrial Products > Packaging

operating_notes.text: Subscribed to 28% equity in AMPIN Energy C&I Twenty-Five Private Limited for captive solar power.
Khopoli, Rudrapur, and Silvassa plants maintain Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) status.
Q1 CY26 raw material costs faced low to medium double-digit inflation due to geopolitical events, which were largely passed through to customers.
Consolidating pressure-sensitive labels operations at two manufacturing facilities and closing one facility, with a total exceptional charge of ₹9.6 Cr.
Operations supported by 10 manufacturing facilities in India with around 2,400 employees.

timeline.summary: Huhtamaki India deferred its Q1FY27 results and appointed Amit Gupta as CFO on April 27, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹613.1 Cr (+0.5% YoY), net profit ₹25.6 Cr (-2.1% YoY).
Huhtamaki India announced Q1 2026 results with net sales of Rs. 5,936 million and EBIT of Rs. 386 million.
Huhtamaki India released its Q1 2026 investor presentation reporting revenue of ₹593.63 Cr and EBITDA of ₹62.08 Cr.
Huhtamaki India Limited shared the earnings call recording for Q1 FY2026 via link on May 13, 2026, signed by Abhijaat Sinha.
Huhtamaki India hosted its Q1 CY26 earnings call on May 13, 2026, reporting a 24.8% YoY increase in EBITDA.
Huhtamaki India submitted its annual promoter shareholding and zero encumbrance confirmation under Regulation 31(4) of SEBI SAST Regulations.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹768.84 Cr (+23.1% YoY), net profit ₹29.73 Cr (-19.1% YoY).
Huhtamaki India reported Q3 2026 net sales of ₹748.1 Cr (up 23.7% YoY) with EBIT before exceptional items of ₹52.1 Cr.
